Concrete defects omitted from the execution summary: (1) `src/lib.rs:15-25` is incompatible with the documented required frontmatter at `docs/human-knowledge-ingestion-contract.md:71-93`—notably numeric `confidence: u8` versus `low | medium | high`, and missing contract, authority, owner, privacy, review, supersession, and affected-scope fields—so contract-conforming notes cannot be ingested by this implementation. (2) `src/lib.rs:56-89` constructs and serializes a `MemoryRecord` but discards it, providing no persistence despite the interface's persistent-memory claim. (3) `src/lib.rs:184-192` accepts absolute and traversal wikilinks containing `/`, joins them without containment validation, and probes `exists()` at `src/lib.rs:173-175`, allowing links to resolve outside the private vault and exposing filesystem existence through returned backlinks. (4) `src/lib.rs:110-114` silently drops directory traversal errors, permitting incomplete scans to be reported as successful. Existing tests cover ordinary links and a missing vault only; they do not cover contract-compliant frontmatter, persistence, traversal containment, or scan errors. No files were modified and no artifacts were created.
